findings.title: Non-issued material reaches S.2A before the issuance gate closes
findings.requirement: Only an issued T.1 envelope may reach S.2A.
evidence: issueRecommendationOutcomeEvidenceV1 invokes completeRepositoryOwnedRecommendationOutcomeEvidenceV2 before it selects the terminal T.1 taxonomy.
The incomplete_missing_closure scenario terminates T.1 as incomplete while retaining a non-null s2a_completion_result_digest.
The focused test missing closure evidence remains incomplete and cannot expose an envelope explicitly requires that non-null S.2A result digest.
findings.impact: The external handoff boundary is inverted: rejected or incomplete issuance material is executed by S.2A even though no issued envelope exists. The output adapter prevents downstream exposure, but it does not satisfy the zero-entry boundary required at the S.2A call itself.
findings.required_future_remediation: Make T.1 determine issuance eligibility without executing S.2A, emit an immutable issued envelope only after all issuance checks pass, and exercise S.2A only through the issued-envelope adapter. Add a zero-S.2A-call assertion for every non-issued taxonomy.

review_dimensions.evidence: Closed property descriptors and the bounded plain-data canonicalizer snapshot the external anchor before the single material callback; callback mutation cannot alter the snapshot.
The canonical anchor projection is plain data, the result snapshot is deeply frozen, and only snapshot values are used in registry comparisons.
Issuer identity/version, authority anchor, trust root, unsigned epoch minimum and exact predecessor digest are externally anchored and fail closed on drift or rollback.
Request, issuer registry, completion registry and canonical observed row independently bind the row identity and digest.

The S.2A V2 validation path enforces integer-nanosecond source, receive, finalization and evaluation ordering, immutable opportunity membership, model/evaluator/outcome/explanation lineage, completeness and finality.
Issuer registry, completion registry and evidence bundle bind source, bundle and trust-root digests without caller authority fields.
The issued fixture contains the closed eighteen-code set; duplicate, missing, extra or conflicting closures fail closed and reordered equivalent closures canonicalize identically.
A missing-closure input invokes S.2A and records its result digest before T.1 returns incomplete.
Five canonical observed-input namespaces, request digest, authority snapshot and sorted reasons bind failures; distinct rejected rows produce distinct failure and terminal digests.
Closed request/authority/material schemas reject caller authority, finality and trust-root claims; accessors, proxies, cycles and budget-extreme values return sanitized fail-closed terminals.
Authority snapshots, issuance envelopes, nested completion material and terminal results are deeply frozen.
Disabled and killed paths return before request or authority inspection, callback, cloning, S.2A execution or input-dependent digest work.
The positive synthetic path reaches issued, completed, bindable, ready, captured and joined; T2-001 remains because negative inputs can also execute S.2A.
UTC A/B, Europe/Stockholm reversed input order and America/New_York reproduce golden digest 1d087e920af0b0bf141fc3aeddbe488956d72fa3e30b53f6519439b99cf9ce9a.
Normalized 303-artifact and replay 84-artifact roots are unchanged, permission-safe and outside Git; no provider, database, writer, persistence or live import exists in T.1 scope.

closed_threat_matrix.threat: Authority callback mutates the external anchor
Issuer epoch rolls back or predecessor is substituted
Caller supplies authority, finality or trust-root claims
One or more of eighteen closure records is invalid
Different rejected observed rows share taxonomy and reasons
Material contains accessors, proxies, cycles or extreme structures
Verified material or terminal output is mutated
Disabled or kill-switch call attempts request, authority, clone, digest or S.2A work
Timezone or scenario ordering changes canonical evidence
Provider, database, writer, dependency or live path enters scope
